svg.title: Catch Up! — tablet portrait wireframes (834 px)
svg.desc: Four tablet-portrait frames: home with a left icon rail, the create wizard in two columns, the options screen with map and list both visible, and the option detail beside a live voting panel.
svg.text: Catch Up! — meeting space planner · TABLET PORTRAIT 834 px
breakpoint 2 of 3 · bottom tab bar becomes a left icon rail · map and list stop being tabs and are shown together

g.text: Invited by Mia · decide by Mon 18:00
Odenplan · max 35 min · quiet, power outlets
Used automatically for every new Catch Up — you never retype them.
✓ synced to every device you sign in on
Responsive change vs mobile: the bottom tab bar becomes a persistent left icon rail, and cards move
from one column to two. Nothing is hidden behind a tab that was reachable on mobile.
The saved-defaults panel is new at this width — there is finally room to show what persistence buys.
Purpose only tunes which spaces we suggest.
Voting closes automatically at this time.
Keeps the candidate list small and fast.
You share a link. Everybody adds their own availability and travel limit.
We fetch spaces, travel times and weather, then score the options.
The group votes. You confirm. Everyone's device updates live.
optional — you can share the link later
Anyone with the link can join and add their own availability. Only you can close the vote.
Nothing is saved to the group until you continue.
Responsive change: the mobile wizard's one-field-per-scroll becomes two columns, so the whole step
fits without scrolling. The step count and the single primary action are unchanged.
T3 · Options — map and list together (no tabs)
Selecting a pin highlights its card, and the other way round.
avg 20 · worst 29 min · 4 of 4 free · step-free ✓
⚠ Sam 41 min — over his 35 min limit
⚠ weather data unavailable — travel and space data still shown
Responsive change: the mobile Map / List tab switch disappears — there is room for both, so selecting
a pin and reading its numbers no longer costs a tap. Each card still shows one bar per member.
A failing source still degrades a single card (option 3), never the whole screen.
T4 · Option detail beside live voting
The app recommends — the group decides. You can always vote for a lower-ranked option.
MapLibre GL — same component, smaller frame
You can change your vote until 18:00.
Each vote is stored under your own user id,
so nobody can overwrite anybody else.
Responsive change: mobile screens 6 and 7 (detail, then vote) become one screen. You can read the
reasoning and cast the vote without navigating, which is where most of the mobile back-and-forth went.
Same components, same copy — only the arrangement differs.
